Expressed as an inline-default token (matching the existing --slider-thumb-{size,bg,shadow} family convention — no stray :root declaration), so a standalone non-dock Slider resolves the dock register too (the felt iOS knob give). RATIFY (Open Q3): inline-default-in-SFC over a theme.css declaration keeps the thumb-token family consistent; a standalone slider defaults to the dock register per the recommendation.
